text:
Halcyon Relay has leased the Brevik ground station, the satellite operator confirmed this week.

The lease was signed on 14 March 2031 and runs for 12 years at a value of 48 million euros. Ingrid Solvang, Director of Ground Infrastructure at Halcyon Relay, confirmed the agreement when contacted by the Gazette.

Details of the deal are set out in the Brevik Ground Station Lease Agreement, which has been filed with the regional port and telecommunications registry. This reporter reviewed the filing and found it matches what Ms. Solvang described.

The station sits on the headland above the harbour, a site many Baywater residents know for its row of white dishes. Under the lease, Halcyon Relay takes over the facility for the full 12-year term.

The Gazette will report further as more information becomes available.
